title: Planning gives a skill-text check that reads the step its goal names, not a line found by its prefix in another step
goal: Retrospective of SP-avwlotax: TK-tbbknjul's goal put the worktree move in kb-sprint run step 2, but its check found the line starting '2. git status --short', which is landing step 4.2; the worker wrote the text there, the check passed, and the review found the move arrives after the claims it must precede (BG-adgc5qf2). kb-sprint plan step 6 and kb/_self/backlog.md Sprints say a check over a skill's text splits the section the goal names (its heading, then its numbered step) before it reads a phrase, and precheck or check warns of a check that selects a line by a numbered prefix the section holds more than once.
